    wcslen, wcsrchr, wcsspn, wcscmp, wcsncmp, wmemcmp, wcschrnul, wcscspn,

+/* RISC-V RVV based wcschr.
+   Copyright (C) 2026 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
+   This file is part of the GNU C Library.
+   Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1+; see COPYING.LESSER.  */
+
+#include <sysdep.h>
+#include <sys/asm.h>
+
+#ifndef WCSCHR
+# define WCSCHR __wcschr
+#endif
+
+#define wcs a0
+#define wc a1
+#define vl_reg a3
+#define first a5
+#define post_vl a6
+
+#define vchunk v16
+#define vhit v0
+#define vtmp v1
+
+ENTRY (WCSCHR)
+.option push
+.option arch, +v
+L(loop):
+	vsetvli	vl_reg, zero, e32, m8, ta, ma
+	vle32ff.v	vchunk, (wcs)
+	vmseq.vx	vtmp, vchunk, wc
+	vmseq.vi	vhit, vchunk, 0
+	vmor.mm	vhit, vhit, vtmp
+	vfirst.m	first, vhit
+	csrr	post_vl, vl
+	bgez	first, L(found)
+	add	wcs, wcs, post_vl
+	j	L(loop)
+L(found):
+	slli	first, first, 2
+	add	a0, wcs, first
+	ret
+.option pop
+END (WCSCHR)
diff --git a/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/riscv/multiarch/wcschr.c b/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/riscv/multiarch/wcschr.c

+++ b/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/riscv/multiarch/wcschr.c

+/* Multiple versions of wcschr.
+   All versions must be listed in ifunc-impl-list.c.
+   Copyright (C) 2026 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
+   This file is part of the GNU C Library.
+   Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1+; see COPYING.LESSER.  */
+
+#if IS_IN (libc)
+# undef wcschr
+# define wcschr __redirect_wcschr
+# include <stdint.h>
+# include <wchar.h>
+# include <ifunc-init.h>
+# include <riscv-ifunc.h>
+# include <sys/hwprobe.h>
+
+extern __typeof (__redirect_wcschr) __libc_wcschr;
+
+extern __typeof (__redirect_wcschr) __wcschr_generic attribute_hidden;
+extern __typeof (__redirect_wcschr) __wcschr_vector attribute_hidden;
+
+static inline __typeof (__redirect_wcschr) *
+select_wcschr_ifunc (uint64_t dl_hwcap, __riscv_hwprobe_t hwprobe_func)
+{
+  unsigned long long v;
+
+  if (__riscv_hwprobe_one (hwprobe_func, RISCV_HWPROBE_KEY_IMA_EXT_0, &v) == 0
+      && (v & RISCV_HWPROBE_IMA_V) == RISCV_HWPROBE_IMA_V)
+    return __wcschr_vector;
+
+  return __wcschr_generic;
+}
+
+riscv_libc_ifunc (__libc_wcschr, select_wcschr_ifunc);
+
+# undef wcschr
+strong_alias (__libc_wcschr, wcschr);
+strong_alias (wcschr, __wcschr)
+# ifdef SHARED
+__hidden_ver1 (wcschr, __GI_wcschr, __redirect_wcschr)
+  __attribute__ ((visibility ("hidden"))) __attribute_copy__ (wcschr);
+# endif
+#else
+# include <wcsmbs/wcschr.c>
+#endif
